config.limitsHint: Read and update the downloader’s global settings. Leave speed limits empty for unlimited speed. Queue limits control how many tasks can run at once. If traffic boosting creates many seeding tasks, raise the seeding or total limit to keep new downloads from queuing.

config.queueHint: Task queues (tasks above the limits wait in the queue)
config.name: Name
config.browseDirectory: Browse and select a server directory…
config.savePathHint: Choose a save directory that MovieClaw can access. If the downloader uses a different path, configure a mapping below. Leave empty to use the downloader’s own default directory. If MovieClaw and the downloader do not share storage, leave this empty.
config.mappingCount: {count, plural, one {# mapping configured} other {# mappings configured}}
config.mappingHint: Mappings are needed when MovieClaw and the downloader run in different containers or hosts and use different paths for the same storage. The save path prefix is translated before submitting a download. For example, map MovieClaw’s <local>/data/downloads</local> to the downloader’s <remote>/downloads</remote>. Leave empty if both use the same paths. Once mappings are configured, every save directory, including library directories, must be covered. Unmapped downloads are rejected to avoid saving into isolated container storage. For directories accessible at the same path, add a mapping with identical paths on both sides.
config.suggestedMapping: The health check suggestion prefilled the MovieClaw path: {path}. Enter the downloader’s corresponding path on the right. If both use the same path, select → to copy it.
config.copyPathHint: Copy the left path to the right when both use the same path
config.incompleteMappings: Complete both sides of every mapping: browse for the left path and enter an absolute downloader path starting with / on the right. Remove any unused rows.
config.duplicateMappings: Each MovieClaw path and each downloader path can appear only once. Edit or remove duplicate rows.
config.rpcHelp: The path defaults to /transmission/rpc when omitted
